statement: The table below gives some values of the function $f$. $$\begin{array}{c|cccccc} x & -2 & -1 & 0 & 1 & 2 & 3 \\ \hline f(x) & 7 & 4 & 3 & 4 & 7 & 12 \end{array}$$ The function $g$ is defined by $g(x) = 2x - 1$. What is the value of $f(g(2))$?

choices.misconception: I worked out g(2) as 2(2 - 1) = 2 instead of 2(2) - 1 = 3, and then read f(2) = 7 from the table.
I did the functions in the wrong order: I read f(2) = 7 from the table and then found g(7) = 13.
I multiplied instead of composing: f(2) = 7 and g(2) = 3, and 7 times 3 is 21.

hints: Work from the inside out: find $g(2)$ first.
Once you have $g(2)$, use that number as the input to $f$ and read the table.

solutions.reliable: First, $g(2) = 2(2) - 1 = 3$. Then $f(g(2)) = f(3)$, and the table gives $f(3) = 12$.
